evidence.recovery_commit_message: recovery(database): restore 19 applied migration payloads from Supabase ledger

interpretation.conclusion: The inspected recovery branch contains all 19 ledger-recovered migration files, but the inspected parent tree contains no supabase/migrations paths. The sampled path history identifies the recovery commit as the commit that introduced the file on that branch. Therefore this branch is a recovery artifact, not independent proof of original historical source-control provenance.

next_steps: Inspect remaining historical branch and tag tip trees for the 19 exact paths, prioritizing branches predating the recovery commit and database-foundation work.
For any candidate source found, record commit SHA, path, Git blob SHA, and compare bytes against the recovered SQL payload.
Inspect historical commit ancestry for candidate source branches to identify the earliest introduction and any later edits.
If no independent original source is found, formally designate ledger-recovered SQL as a reconstructed recovery baseline with explicit provenance limitations.
Build a separate canonical bootstrap only from independently reviewed prerequisites and source files; rehearse in disposable PostgreSQL, never against production.
